prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1192; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in the motor vehicle collision referenced above. Our client was injured in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical care for those injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office, and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits for the at-fault driver's policy, along with a complete declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, telematics, dashcam footage, recorded statements, claim file notes, repair and salvage records, and any communications with the other driver or witnesses. Any alteration, repair, or disposal of the vehicles involved should be avoided until our office has had the opportunity to inspect them.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter in writing within fourteen days.
